Mike L: adding a +1 for Pinecone as best model nickname.

Sara K: tally so far: Pinecone 2, RedwoodRanger 1, Maple 1. Close race!

LunchBot: Poll closed. Result: :two: Cookies + VS Code + 'Pinecone' wins (2 votes).

Mike L: Sweet. Heading to kitchen in 3 — who wants chocolate chip? :cookie:

Aj: I'll take one, thanks.

Zara P: I'll bring thermos of coffee in 10.

Sara K: Thanks everyone — cookies incoming :tada: :heart:
